content:
maria_cs: Quick heads-up — Bluecliff's onboarding health flagged after a spike this morning, want to propose a proactive perf plan before renewal.

sam_se: What did the spike look like? numbers?

maria_cs: p50 95ms, p95 380ms, p99 1.05s. Avg tokens/request 460, support flows often 250-600 tokens. Peak at 14:00 UTC. They call out slow chat experiences in demo.

opsbot: Alert: bluecliff-prod latency breach at 2026-03-15T14:02:11Z — p99 above 1s for 7min.

sam_se: Suggestion: introduce token-length routing + a compact int8 model for short/medium requests. Keep a stable fp16 path for long/critical queries. Canary small % first. Should reclaim latency and cut token cost.

jamie_re: Agreed. Also add prefix KV cache for their common system prompts (we've seen repeated system prompt across 30% of requests). 1h TTL should help.

sam_se: Draft canary config (keep it small):
```
routes:
  - name: compact_path
    match: tokens <= 300
    model: gpt-compact-4q
    quant: int8
  - name: stable_path
    match: tokens > 300
    model: gpt-xl-bridge-v2
    quant: fp16
canary: 5%
metrics: [p50,p95,p99,error_rate,token_cost,hallucination_rate]
eval_set: bluecliff-regen-200
cache:
  prefix_kv: true
  ttl_seconds: 3600
```

maria_cs: Nice. Action items: 1) Enablement call with Bluecliff TOMORROW 10:00am PT — @jamie_re to lead, @sam_se to present technical plan. 2) Capture 200 sample prompts during call for quality checks. 3) Run 48h canary, then compare latency/cost + manual quality review. 4) Prepare renewal slide with projected savings and latency delta.

jamie_re: I'll run the enablement and collect prompts. I'll ask them to flag "support flow" examples. Also will add a simple regen checklist for QA.

sam_se: I'll kick off the canary job after call and wire dashboard alerts for any error rate uptick. Will also run synthetic perf test on compact model with their distribution.

opsbot: Canary job scheduled: bluecliff/proactive-compact-route/5180000000 (5% traffic).

maria_cs: Great — I'll prep the renewal note and slot a follow-up 1 week before renewal to review metrics. Thanks team :thumbsup:

jamie_re: Quick reminder — include cost projection both for hosted vs dedicated (they asked earlier). I'll pull usage tiers.

sam_se: Noted. I'll include per-token cost delta and estimated monthly savings under expected traffic.

maria_cs: Closing for now, will post call notes after enablement.
